ninefix.configuration.title: NINE Performance Fixes
ninefix.configuration.section.ninefix.st: NINE Performance Fixes - restart the game after changes
ninefix.configuration.geckolibAnimationF: Makes GeckoLib skip resource folders it can't read (e.g. Mining & Placing Animations), so GeckoLib mobs animate again and stop writing an error to the log every frame. Restart the game to apply.
ArPhEx rebuilds the same sphere mesh twice every frame. Build it once and reuse it. Restart the game to apply.
ninefix.configuration.arphexTrophyScan.t: ArPhEx searches every block entity in every loaded chunk every frame for its mob trophies. Re-check each chunk about once a second instead. Restart the game to apply.
ninefix.configuration.fancymenuScreenCac: FancyMenu works out the current screen's name thousands of times per frame. Remember the answer until the screen changes. Restart the game to apply.
ninefix.configuration.skillExpConfigCach: SkillExpNotifier re-reads its config file from disk every frame. Keep it in memory (re-read at most every 2 seconds). Restart the game to apply.
ninefix.configuration.kubejsHighlightBuf: KubeJS clears and copies its highlight buffers every frame even when nothing is highlighted. Skip that work while nothing is highlighted. Restart the game to apply.
ninefix.configuration.kubejsWebServerOff: KubeJS: turn off the web server
KubeJS runs a small web server for script developers, and its loop keeps about 3/4 of a CPU core busy nonstop. Players don't need it. Restart the game to apply.
ninefix.configuration.vanillaBackportLea: VanillaBackport builds a brand-new colour cache for every leaf block Distant Horizons draws and throws it away. Work the colour out directly instead (same colour). Restart the game to apply.
ninefix.configuration.distantHorizonsThr: Distant Horizons: use at most half the CPU

The pack lets Distant Horizons use every CPU core, which starves the game while it loads distant terrain. Cap it at half your CPU threads (its own default). Doesn't change its config file. Restart the game to apply.
ninefix.configuration.obsessedNetworkFix: The Obsessed: stop the network flood (server)

The Obsessed resends each player's data dozens of times per tick, flooding the connection. Send it once per tick, with the latest values. Only does something on the server (or in single player). Restart the game to apply.
